reference: C. Monterola & C. Saloma, Solving the nonlinear Schrodinger equation with an unsupervised neural network, Opt. Express 9, 72 (2001), doi:10.1364/OE.9.000072

pde.equation: -j dPsi/dz + (beta/2) d2Psi/dt2 - gamma |Psi|^2 Psi = 0   (paper Eq. 4; t in units of the pulse width, z in units of the propagation length)

analytic_solutions.A: Psi = (1 - j z)^(-1/2) exp[ -t^2 / (2 (1 - j z)) ]   (+j branch per paper Eq. 4 sign convention)
analytic_solutions.B: Psi = exp(-t^2/2) exp( j z exp(-t^2) )
analytic_solutions.C: no closed form; repepititious oracle = photonics_helper SplitStepEngine (float64)

pde.input_pulses: Gaussian Psi0 = exp(-t^2/2) (the sech soliton variant of the paper needs beta = -1, gamma = 1 and is NOT one of the paper's three NLSE cases; skipped)

paper_training.training: adaptive-eta gradient descent (rules in Sec. 4.1); energy function Eq. (7): |F|^2 + |C1|^2 + |C2|^2

quoted_results.note: NMSE xi = sum |Psi - Psi^q|^2 / sum |Psi|^2 over 2e4 test datapoints (paper Sec. 4.2)

engine_mapping.note: normalized (t, z) -> (tau = t*T0, z = z*L) with T0 = 1 ps, L = 1 m; engine dispersion kernel exp(i*beta*k*Omega^k) reproduces Eq. (4) for beta2 > 0 with gamma > 0

pinn.trial_ansatz: Psi = exp(-t^2/2) + z * N(z, t)  (initial condition enforced by construction; paper Sec. 2.2 energy terms C1 absorbed)
pinn.far_field_energy_term: |Psi|^2 + |Psi_t|^2 at t = +-27 boundary lines (paper Eq. 6 / C2)

assert_bands.note: the paper's NMSE benchmarks come from only 200 adaptive-gradient iterations; our Adam budget is 150x larger, so the same orders of magnitude are the target
